title: Stratifications
statement:
A *stratification* of a topological space $T$ is a finite family
$(T_k)_{k<n}$ of pairwise disjoint locally closed subsets covering $T$
(Stacks Project, Tag `09XZ`, with finiteness added). A
*stratification* of a scheme $X$ is a stratification $(X_k)_{k<n}$ of
its underlying space together with, for each $k$, a scheme $Z_k$ and an
immersion $\iota_k\colon Z_k\to X$ with set-theoretic image $X_k$.

lean.statement: structure LocallyClosedStratification (X : Scheme.{w}) extends Topology.Stratification X
lean.note: The recorded source Scheme.Stratification now additionally requires isConstructible_stratum, absent from this node. LocallyClosedStratification states exactly the node: the existing Topology.Stratification together with schemes, immersions, and their image equalities, without constructibility. Topology.Stratification remains the existing topological notion.
